name: Special City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA

  MONDAY, JANUARY 13, 2020
  6:30 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
This time is for members of the public to address the City Council on Closed Session Item
No. 1. Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and
give that card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting.
Please observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  1. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  (Government Code Section 54957.6)
  City Negotiator: Interim City Attorney Christi Hogin
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager

RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

ADJOURNMENT
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.
minutes_text:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA

  MONDAY, JANUARY 13, 2020
  6:30 P.M.
The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 6:30 p.m., on Monday,
January 13, 2020 in the Artesia City Council Chambers by Mayor Ali Taj.

PRESENT:  Ali Taj, Mayor
  Rene Trevino, Mayor Pro Tem
  Tony Lima, Councilmember

ABSENT:  Miguel Canales, Councilmember
  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember

ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Christi Hogin, Interim City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistant City Clerk

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION ORDERED BY MAYOR TAJ

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

  City Clerk presented the announcement.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  1. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  (Government Code Section 54957.6)
  City Negotiator: Interim City Attorney Christi Hogin
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager

  Interim City Attorney announced the Item for Closed Session.

  Mayor Taj recessed the meeting to Closed Session.

RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION

  Interim City Attorney reported that Councilmember Canales joined the Closed
  Session at 6:33 p.m., and that Councilmember Ramoso joined the Closed Session at
  6:34 p.m.

  1
   Interim City Attorney reported that the City Council considered the one agendized
  item, and there was no reportable action on the item.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the Special Meeting.

  2
